research_flags.Chovancek-You: Chovancek UFC debut; You has Road to UFC tournament win plus UFC experience. Keep model side but lower trust.
research_flags.Croden-Chandler: Croden active and improving; Chandler enters off a first-round submission win. Near-coinflip model; no flip.
research_flags.Anheliger-Koslow: Both long layoffs; Koslow one UFC bout and inactive since Dec 2022. Strong sparse/inactivity downgrade.
research_flags.Cerminara-Stiller: Stiller debuting, moving up a division, replacement; Cerminara former title challenger returning from childbirth/long layoff. Extreme uncertainty; no side flip.
research_flags.Mahjoub-Faglier: Both unbeaten UFC newcomers; Mahjoub Olympic-level judo, Faglier 6-0 and beat UFC vet Cody East. Keep slight Mahjoub lean only.
research_flags.Leblanc-Galanti: Leblanc stopped in UFC debut; Galanti six-fight streak and 35-second DWCS stoppage. Material conflict with model; downgrade heavily/pass, no overwrite.
research_flags.Boser-Diniz: Both established; both enter off losses. No material model-input error; Boser side retained.
research_flags.Nallo-Landwehr: Nallo dangerous finisher; Landwehr 38, moving to lightweight after three straight stoppage losses. Research conflicts with slight Landwehr model lean; downgrade to pass.
research_flags.Jourdain-Cuamba: Jourdain UFC debut after DWCS and year layoff; Cuamba 2-3 UFC and 1-1 at bantamweight. Keep Jourdain lean, lower trust.
research_flags.Barriault-Daukaus: Barriault pressure is stylistic danger for Daukaus; Daukaus has recent UFC return wins and one recent loss. Retain Daukaus.
research_flags.Nelson-Perez: Perez UFC debut with 12 finishes in 15 wins; Nelson experienced and 4-2 over last six. Retain Perez model side but sparse downgrade.
research_flags.Blanchfield-Jasudavicius: Established top contenders; Blanchfield 8-1 UFC, Jasudavicius strong recent run. Retain Blanchfield.
research_flags.Buckley-Malott: Buckley two straight losses with grappling/control problems; Malott four-fight win streak and recent Burns stoppage. Retain Buckley model side but reduce confidence; KO remains model's top path.
